name: dbt-column-lineage
description: Trace a dbt model column back to its raw sources and view it as an interactive diagram, right in VS Code.

dbtLineage.manifestPath.description: Path to dbt's manifest.json, relative to the workspace root (or absolute). Requires `dbt compile` / `dbt build` / `dbt run`, not `dbt parse`.

dbtLineage.catalogPath.description: Optional path to catalog.json (from `dbt docs generate`). Leave empty to use catalog.json next to the manifest, if present — this enables SELECT * expansion.

dbtLineage.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the lineage tracer. Must have sqlglot installed (see the bundled scripts/requirements.txt).

dbtLineage.scriptPath.description: Path to column_lineage.py. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with this extension.

dbtLineage.dialect.description: Optional sqlglot dialect override (e.g. 'snowflake', 'bigquery'). Leave empty to infer from the manifest's adapter_type.

dbtLineage.diagramFormat.description: Diagram renderer for the lineage panel. 'dot' uses Graphviz (via WASM) for a more compact layout on wide graphs.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Run "dbt Lineage: Trace Column" from the Command Palette to see a column's lineage here.
[Trace Column](command:dbtLineage.traceColumn)
